name: Aman Kumar Prajapati
title: Aman Kumar Prajapati
description: Research portfolio of Aman Kumar Prajapati: self-supervised learning, learning from imperfect data, physics informed models and AI for cancer diagnostics.
role: AI and Computer Vision Engineer, Big Vision LLC, Bangalore
statement: I work on making vision models small enough, through quantization, and stable enough to run where the data actually is: on a microscope slide scanner, on a satellite bus, on a single GPU serving fifty live cameras.
sub: That has taken me through self supervised detection for pathology, physics informed anomaly detection, quantization aware training, and sensor fusion for grain storage. The thread is the same across all of them: work out what the constraint really is, then design the representation around it.

interests.title: Learning from imperfect data
interests.text: Models that stay reliable when labels are scarce, noisy or missing altogether.

interests.title: Self supervised learning
interests.text: Representations learned from unlabeled data, so expert annotation is spent only where it matters.

interests.title: Physics informed world models
interests.text: Learned models of how systems evolve that respect known dynamics, and can say when an observation breaks them.

interests.title: AI for medicine
interests.text: Developing medical foundation models for cancer detection and diagnosis pretrained on pathology and clinical data, and deployable, interpretable tools for detection and diagnosis across other medical domains.
